description: ASML faces intensified lobbying and legal threats from the U.S. government to restrict not only advanced EUV exports to China but also older DUV systems used in Chinese fabs for mature-node chips. The pressure extends to denying servicing and spare parts, risking production halts at non-Chinese fabs reliant on ASML’s global maintenance network. This tests the EU’s ability to defend its industrial sovereignty against extraterritorial enforcement of U.S. export controls.
